products.title: Mars 2020 MEDA Air Temperature Sensor Calibrated Data
products.instrument: MEDA ATS (Air Temperature Sensor), calibrated level
products.site_note: Perseverance rover, Jezero crater. lat/lon are the approximate landing site from SPEC_P09; the rover's exact position on this sol is in the MEDA DER_ANCILLARY file, which was not downloaded.
products.quality: Calibrated ATS (MEDA publishes no derived ATS product). Per 1 Hz sample: median of the three mast (RSM) sensors ATS_LOCAL_TEMP1-3 that read between 100 and 350 K, at least two needed. The two rover-body (RFB) sensors ATS_LOCAL_TEMP4-5 are not used. The choice of the RSM median is this project's processing, not a MEDA-defined quantity.

products.pds_lid: none (not a PDS product: LMD Mars dust climatology research archive)
products.title: Martian dust scenario MY35 (kriged daily maps of column dust optical depth), Montabone et al.
products.mission: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (Mars Climate Sounder v5.2 retrievals, gridded and kriged at LMD)
products.instrument: MRO MCS column dust optical depth, LMD dust climatology v2.5 (Montabone et al. 2015, 2020)
products.site_note: bilinear interpolation of the four 3 x 3 degree grid cells at [19.5, 16.5] N x [75.0, 78.0] E around the landing site
products.sol_basis: sol of Mars year 35 (LMD calendar, Montabone et al. 2015 appendix A); column 'sol' is the file's fractional Time
products.quality: Kriged (complete-coverage) maps, one per sol. 'reliability' is the file's cdodrel (kriged reliability of the grid point). No values were dropped; a grid value that is not finite or below zero would be written as -999.0 (none occurred).
products.license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported (the file's 'copyright' attribute and the LMD page: "publicly available with open access, under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License"). Credit: Montabone et al. (2015, 2020), LMD Mars dust climatology. Changes made: values interpolated to Jezero and converted as listed in 'transform'.
transform: downloaded by HTTP byte ranges: the NetCDF header with all 1-D variables (30464 bytes) and, for each of the 669 maps and for cdodrel, cdod610 and cdodtot, the 488 bytes from grid cell (lat 19.5, lon 75.0) to (lat 16.5, lon 78.0); the full file is 57832064 bytes
bilinear interpolation to 18.44 N, 77.45 E (weights: 0.8167 towards 78.0 E, 0.3533 towards 16.5 N)
cdod610: 9.3 um absorption column dust optical depth normalised to 610 Pa (file unit Pa/Pa, written as 1)
cdodtot: 9.3 um absorption column dust optical depth of the total column down to the grid point surface
tau_vis = 2.6 x cdodtot: the LMD page's factor for an equivalent visible column optical depth
ls written as in the file (the first map of a year may carry Ls just below 360)
